Name: Sihon
Summary: Sihon was king of the Amorites at Heshbon; he refused Israel passage and was defeated, and his land became Israel's first possession east of the Jordan.
KeyStory: Sihon gathered his people and fought Israel at Jahaz, and Israel took all his cities from the Arnon to the Jabbok.
LifeLesson: The door God opens is often the one a king tries to shut.
